types.name: LiquidityHeatmapProps
types.doc: A grid heatmap of resting liquidity: time runs left to right, price bottom to top, and each cell is tinted by the size waiting at that price. Columns sweep in from the left, then the traded price draws over them. A crosshair and a ring glide to the cell under the pointer or the arrow keys, and the readout above and the marker on the legend follow it.

members.name: times
members.doc: Label of each time bucket, oldest first. One column per entry.

members.name: prices
members.doc: Price of each level, evenly spaced. Any order: the chart draws the highest price at the top.

members.name: values
members.doc: Size resting in each cell, as `values[timeIndex][priceIndex]`. Missing cells count as zero.

members.name: path
members.doc: Traded price at each time bucket, drawn as a line over the grid.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the chart, such as "BTC-USD resting liquidity, last four hours".

members.name: unit
members.doc: Unit written after a size, such as "BTC".

members.name: formatPrice
members.doc: Formats a price for the axis and the readout.

members.name: formatValue
members.doc: Formats a size for the readout and the legend.

members.name: max
members.doc: Size at which the color saturates. Defaults to the largest size in the data.

members.name: height
members.doc: Height of the plot in px, time axis included.

members.name: onCellChange
members.type: (cell: { time: string; price: number; value: number } | null) => void
members.doc: Called when the cell under the pointer or the keyboard changes; null when the chart goes back to the latest column.

members.name: locale
members.doc: Formatting locale. Fixed by default so server and client render the same labels.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the root element.
